title: Plane integrals of the unit-ball cut-offs converge to ω_n
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ and T ∈ G(N,n). For k ∈ ℕ and y ∈ ℝ^N put φ_k⁺(y) = max(0, 1 − (k+1)·max(0, ‖y‖ − 1)) and φ_k⁻(y) = min(1, (k+1)·max(0, 1 − ‖y‖)). Then, as k → ∞, ∫_{T.plane} φ_k⁺ dH^n → ω_n and ∫_{T.plane} φ_k⁻ dH^n → ω_n. Here H^n = μHE[n] on ℝ^N, the integrals are real Bochner integrals over T.plane (with respect to μHE[n] restricted to T.plane), and ω_n = (unitBallVolume n).toReal.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (T : Grassmannian N n), Tendsto (fun k : ℕ ↦ ∫ y in (T.plane : Set (Euclidean N)), max 0 (1 - ((k : ℝ) + 1) * max 0 (‖y‖ - 1)) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N))) atTop (𝓝 (unitBallVolume n).toReal) ∧ Tendsto (fun k : ℕ ↦ ∫ y in (T.plane : Set (Euclidean N)), min 1 (((k : ℝ) + 1) * max 0 (1 - ‖y‖)) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N))) atTop (𝓝 (unitBallVolume n).toReal)
